caption.text:
Viral, video Lurah Pasir Jaya Syerly diduga ejek warga yang mengeluhkan lampu penerangan jalan umum kepada Wali Kota Medan Rico Waas.

Terkait kejadian itu, Inspektorat Kota Medan memanggil dan meminta klarifikasi langsung kepada Syerly.

"Hasil pemeriksaan, terindikasi kuat melanggar kode etik," ujar Inspektur Kota Medan Erfin Fahrurrazi, Rabu (29/7/2026).

Syerly diduga melanggar Peraturan Wali Kota (Perwal) Medan Nomor 58 Tahun 2023 tentang Penegakan Disiplin dan Kode Etik Pegawai Aparatur Sipil Negara.

🎥: IG @lensadaily_, @kelurahan_pasirjaya

Penulis: Cristison Sondang Pane, Eris Eka Jaya
Kreatif: Muchammad Chadziq Hanggeni Utomo
Produser: Reza Kurnia Darmawan

- #Medan #Peristiwa #Read
caption.text_translation:
Viral, video of Lurah Pasir Jaya Syerly allegedly mocked citizens who complained of public street lighting to Medan Mayor Rico Waas.

Regarding the incident, the Medan City Inspectorate called and requested immediate clarification to Syerly.

"The results of the inspection are strongly indicated that the violation of the code of ethics," said Medan City Inspector Erfin Fahrurrazi, Wednesday (29/7/2026).

Syerly allegedly violated the Mayor's Regulation (Perwal) Field Number 58 of 2023 on the Enforcement of Discipline and Code of Ethics of Civil Apparatus Officers of the State.

 🎥: IG @lensadaily_, @kelurahan_pasirjaya 

 Penulis: Cristison Sondang Pane, Eris Eka Jaya 
 Kreatif: Muchammad Chadziq Hanggeni Utomo 
 Produser: Reza Kurnia Darmawan 

 - #Medan #Peristiwa #Read
